title: Edit Employee Personal Details (PIM Module)
description:
h2. *Scenario 1: Edit Employee Personal Details (PIM Module)*

h3. *Description*

Navigate to an existing employee record and update one or more personal details (e.g., nickname, marital status, nationality, or other editable fields).

h3. *Acceptance Criteria*

* User can navigate to the *PIM* module.
* User can search for and open an existing employee record.
* User can edit one or more editable employee details.
* User can save the updated information successfully.
* A success confirmation message is displayed.
* Updated details persist after refreshing the page or reopening the employee record.
* No validation or application errors are displayed during the update.
